# Utilize [Action]

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Actions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#UtilizeAction)*

You normally interact with an object while doing something else, such as when you draw a sword as part of the [Attack](Attack.md) action. When an object requires an action for its use, you take the Utilize action.
